tests.reason: Windows denied the test-only symlink creation in scripts/project-doc-site.spec.ts with EPERM; every repository-content gate passed.

acceptance: Device Trust persists separately branded Session and Workspace grants with each paired device; pairing code consumption, device creation, and grant insertion commit atomically.
Product endpoints carry fixed non-overridable resource policies, and custom endpoints must declare unscoped access explicitly.
Session, Workspace, resource, path, and interaction checks run before the existing business owners; Session and Workspace collections plus Remote Event values are filtered before socket output.
Artifact, Attachment, and Workspace path membership remain owned by their existing controllers after the paired-device top-level grant check.
Remote interaction answers require controller role, the independent approval switch, the device-owned authoritative Host clientId, pending delivery, and Session access.
Gateway remains the sole pending interaction owner; Link Access only checks pending delivery, claims one attempt, or delegates to the existing waterfall.
Approval disable, device revocation, and carrier stop delegate retained interactions; ordinary disconnect preserves Gateway pending state for reconnect replay.
A committed direct Device Trust revocation emits device-trust/revoked and closes the matching active Link event generation.
Observer mutation, unauthorized Session, Workspace, resource, path, stale generation, duplicate interaction, disabled approval, and revoked-device paths are denied by tests.
knownLimitations: The Windows host cannot create the documentation test symlink without Developer Mode or elevated symlink privilege. No product code or documentation was changed to mask that host limitation.

One carrier restart test observed an ASN.1 read failure while seven tsx checks were launched concurrently under sandbox pressure; the isolated test and the complete eight-file suite both passed serially, so no TLS behavior was changed.
This task intentionally implements only the current Remote endpoint Session, Workspace, Interaction, resource, and path scopes; complex enterprise RBAC remains deferred.

notExecuted.details: Windows returned EPERM when the test attempted to create a symlink. The failure is independent of repository content.
